reasons: Population inference is not enabled: policy and both run sampling declarations must explicitly claim independent groups; declarations are not proof.
The evidence does not establish all required non-inferiority claims; absence of detected regression is not passage.
warnings: Bootstrap intervals are descriptive approximations and never determine the release decision.
Group identifiers and hashes verify organization/identity, not independence, representative sampling, correctness, or absence of training contamination.
Coverage assumes the policy, sample size, groups and slices were fixed before inspecting outcomes; repeated peeking or tuning until passage is unsupported.
A pass concerns these scores and the specified tolerance, not global model superiority or production safety.
Synthetic fixtures validate the evaluation software and finite-suite contracts; they are not measured model capabilities or IID population evidence.
